message:
Dear {{ doc.visitor_full_name }},

Your visit is approved. Reference: {{ doc.name }}.

When: {{ doc.visit_date }}, {{ doc.expected_checkin }}–{{ doc.expected_checkout }}
Host: {{ doc.host_name or doc.person_to_visit }} · Purpose: {{ doc.purpose_of_visit }}

{% if doc.qr_code_image %}
Show this code at the security gate. You can also save this email or take a screenshot.
{% else %}

Your QR pass is being generated and will follow in a separate email shortly.

{% endif %}

On arrival

  • Carry a valid photo ID matching the one you registered with.
  • Show the QR code above at the gate for verification.
  • Your physical badge will be issued at the security desk after item verification.
    • {% if doc.visitor_type == 'Contractor' %}
  • Complete the required safety induction and wear the provided PPE.
    • {% endif %}

This is an automated email. Contact your host for changes or queries.
name: VMS Approval Email
subject: Visit approved — {{ doc.visit_date }}
